question: The Chhath Puja festival is dedicated to the _________ God.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sun.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chhath Puja festival** is dedicated to the** Sun God**, also known as** Surya.**
 
• The festival is celebrated primarily in **Bihar, Jharkhand**, and parts of **Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• It is a** four-day festival **that includes** fasting, holy bathing, and offering prayers** to the Sun God.
 
• The festival is believed to bring **prosperity, good health, and happiness** to the devotees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Informations__**

 
• **Vishnu** is a Hindu God known as the **preserver of the universe.**

 
 
• He is one of the three major deities in **Hinduism,** along with **Brahma and Shiva.**
 
 
 
• **Indra **is a Hindu God known as th**e king of the gods** and the **god of lightning, thunder, and rain.**
 
• **Brahma** is a Hindu God known as the **creator of the universe**.
 
 
• He is one of the **three major deities** in Hinduism, along with Vishnu and Shiva.
